title: Great pans, not dishwasher safe
text: Great pans, not dishwasher safe. I got these pans as a gift and put them in the dishwasher thinking aluminum pans would be fine in there. (It didn't say anywhere on amazon on the wilton papers that came with it that it wasn't dishwasher safe). When I took them out they had lost all of their coating. I returned them. We now have 2 sets of these and hand wash them every time. They aren't as shiny as they were and I'm sure the coating will wear off eventually but they bake well and are working for us for now.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Round Cake Pans, Aluminum, 4 Piece Set for 6-Inch, 8-Inch, 10-Inch and 12-Inch Cakes
features: READY, SET, BAKE: For all your cake baking needs. This set of four round cake pans made of durable, even heating aluminum were built to last for many years to come
PERFORMANCE: The anodized aluminum construction of these Wilton cake pans resists rust and ensures even heating for uniform baking

CONVENIENT: The generous 2-inch depth works well for creating cakes with higher layers. From a smash cake for baby's first birthday to a cake large enough to serve a crowd, there's a cake pan for that
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Not dishwasher safe; before first and after each use, wash these round cake pans in warm, soapy water for best results
INCLUDES: 4 cake pans, dimensions: 6 x 2 in. (15 x 5 cm) 8 x 2 in. (20.3 x 5 cm), 10 x 2 in. (25.4 x 5 cm) and 12 x 2 in. (30.4 x 5 cm) size pans
